# Official OpenLOCK source and modifications

OpenLOCK system, official tessellation templates 8.6 and Clip 5.4 by Printable Scenery (https://www.printablescenery.com/). Terrain Foundry sockets are derived directly from the official A-TRP-v7.0 template; two sacrificial entrance supports are omitted. MGN Consultancy uses the system under its non-transferable commercial BSD licence: https://www.printablescenery.com/2026/10/01/mgn-consultancy/. The MGN licence is not transferred to recipients. Other users retain the public CC BY-NC 4.0 terms unless they obtain their own commercial permission. Original connector-free Terrain Foundry sculpts are CC0; imported models retain their own rights. Print a fit test first; physical fit is not yet verified.

Source: https://www.printablescenery.com/product/open-lock/
Archive: OpenLOCK Tessellation Templates 8.6, downloaded 1 October 2026.
Pinned file hashes and archive entries: official/provenance.json.

The socket generator crops the central port and latch relief from A-TRP-v7.0.stl, removes its two sacrificial support posts, quantizes sub-micron export noise, and transforms to the editor’s Y-up coordinates. Official 7 mm template socket heights are retained inside the editor’s existing 8 mm floors. Scene dimensions and port placement are preserved. Clip 5.4 is unchanged except translation to the export origin. No third-party community implementation is incorporated.

Source: https://www.printablescenery.com/2026/10/01/mgn-consultancy/
Retrieved: 2026-10-01
